-- class: expand

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."tasks" (
  "id" bigint generated always as identity not null,
  "status" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create function "public"."is_open"("status" text) returns boolean language sql immutable security invoker as $okm$select status <> 'done'$okm$;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-view
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create view "public"."open_tasks" as SELECT id
   FROM tasks
  WHERE is_open(status);

steps.sql:
create table "public"."tasks" (
  "id" bigint generated always as identity not null,
  "status" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")
)
create function "public"."is_open"("status" text) returns boolean language sql immutable security invoker as $okm$select status <> 'done'$okm$

create view "public"."open_tasks" as SELECT id
   FROM tasks
  WHERE is_open(status)
